text:
jon (eng-infra PM): Quick sync — need to lock down Q3/Q4 capacity cadence and procurement buffer rules for Dedicated and Private launches. Proposal: monthly procurement cadence, 6-week vendor lead target, default 10% safety buffer, APAC +5% buffer. also want an on-call escalation flow when burn > 85% for 3 days. Thoughts?

maria (infra lead): +1 to cadence but prefer 8-week lead for H100s. supply volatility still high. 10% OK for NA/EU but agree APAC needs +5%. we should also carve a small reserved burst pool for enterprise accounts. :thinking_face:

lee (finance): Heads-up — we only have headroom for ~8% buffer at current run-rate without reforecast. If we push to 15% for APAC we'll need to move some CAPEX or delay noncritical refresh. can we have a tiered buffer tied to committed MRR?

sanjay (prod): From customer asks: several enterprise pilots require guaranteed throughput and regional pinning. If we don't shape buffer around those, we'll have churn risk. propose reserving 20% of buffer capacity for committed customers (configurable per-contract).

anya (sre): On-call angle: we need an automated fallback before human page. my suggestion: threshold-based auto-shift -> if region utilization > 90% and queue latencies spike, route new requests to fallback variants (lower batch size / quantized model) + alert paging. also need a one-page runbook exercise for ops-oncall to rehearse these transitions.

vendor-bot: latest vendor ETA pack for H100 and A800: 
```
vendor: "AcmeGPUs"
sku: ["H100-80GB", "A800-80GB"]
eta_weeks: { "H100-80GB": 7, "A800-80GB": 5 }
min_order_qty: 16
lead_variability_weeks: 2
```
(ETA = current estimate, variability +/- weeks)

jon (eng-infra PM): OK — sounds like we need to reconcile finance + product + ops. my adjusted proposal based on feedback: monthly cadence for common SKUs, 8-week lead target for H100 class with vendor buffer, baseline safety buffer 9% (NA/EU), APAC 14%, reserved enterprise bucket 18% (configurable per-contract). On-call: implement auto-fallback policy then page ops if fallback > 5% of traffic for 10m.

lee (finance): That split is workable if we gate the reserved enterprise bucket by contract signatures > $50k/mo. finance can approve reforecast if we get signoff by end of quarter.

maria (infra lead): Need to add metrics to console: per-region reserved pool usage, buffer burn rate, vendor ETA variance. I'll draft a telemetry spec.

anya (sre): i'll draft the runbook and a chaos test for the routing fallback. recommend we run the test in staging next week. ops-oncall can take a dry-run.

jon (eng-infra PM): action items: 
- maria -> telemetry spec for reserved/buffer metrics (due 3 days)
- anya -> runbook + chaos test plan (due 5 days)
- lee -> reforecast runway & approval criteria (due EOW)
- sanjay -> list of enterprise contracts needing pinned capacity (due 4 days)
- maria + procurement -> reach out to AcmeGPUs for firm 8-week lead commitment, ask for price hold for 30 days (due 7 days)

jon (eng-infra PM): please react with :thumbsup: if you agree or :eyes: if you need changes. planning to finalize cadence in Monday roadmap sync.

maria (infra lead): :thumbsup:

anya (sre): :thumbsup:

lee (finance): :eyes: will update by EOW

sanjay (prod): :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: noted, will schedule dry-run and confirm on-call availability next Tue.

jon (eng-infra PM): thanks everyone — pushing this into the roadmap doc after Monday if no objections.
